chunks.text: Awards include: - Global Economics: Best CSR Programs for Telecom Companies Locally and Internationally (2024). - Al-Orman: Recognition for supporting the healthcare sector. - Top 5 Investor Relations in Egypt (2018). - Best CSR Initiative in the World Communication Awards (2019). - Best Investor Relations - Telecom Company - 2024 at the 12th Annual International Finance Awards. - Best Investor Relations Award for traded companies (2010 GTM/EGX). - Best Website Award (2010 Egypt Web Academy Awards).
